verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no dedicated sandbox, staging, or test environment kept separate from production data or workspaces. A free 10,000-page tier, a quickstart that uses a sample annual report, and dedicated or VPC instances with data isolation are present, but none of these is described as a sandbox or test environment. Because a SaaS data-processing platform could plausibly offer one, the axis applies, so the verdict is "none" rather than "na".
